status: Kin direction chosen 19 Nov 2026. Working balance numbers.
stat_scale: Rulebook 1.2.5 working scale, about double Battlegrounds. Mice sit under the usual body on purpose, most of all in Health.
shared_rules: ../SHARED-RULES.md is the glossary and the rulings between tribes. Keyword spellings and reminder text here are copied from it; where the two differ, it wins.

rules.pile_on: Rulebook 11.7.11. Several sources add their N and hit once per neighbour attack.
rules.hand_me_down: Rulebook 11.7.12–13. Fewest neighbour steps, ties in reading order. Only own Attack passes.

keywords.Hand-me-down: When this dies, the nearest friendly Mouse gains its Attack this fight.
keywords.Pile on N: The first N times a neighbour attacks each fight, this hits the target first.
